blocks.text: [ K-IG 교육- principle04]
Principle 4: Relative Introduction
Let me introduce my relatives to you.
Let me tell you about my relatives.
I have many relatives because my father
and mother have many brothers and sisters.
First of all, my father has two brothers and two sisters.
My mother also has two brothers and two sisters.
My father is the second son. My grandparents live with my oldest uncle.
Some of my aunts and uncles live near my house so I often go and visit
them, or they come and visit me.
My mother is the youngest child in her family.
She has two older brothers and two sisters.
My uncles and aunts are all married, so I have a lot of cousins as well.
Because grandfather passed away several years ago,
my grandmother lives with my mother’s eldest brother.
My favorite relative is my oldest uncle, 길동.
He lives on the other side of town,
and my family visits him twice a month.
When we get together we usually go out for dinner.
My oldest uncle has many skills and talents.
He can fix cars and play soccer very well.
He can play all kinds of sports,
and he can play the piano and guitar pretty well.
He is also a very generous and kind person.
He always gives me candy when I visit him.
He can speak English very fluently, so I really look up to him a lot.
